data: After a recap of material from Linear Algebra (generalised to arbitrary fields), we will introduce quotients of vector spaces and study their properties. The course then covers a spectrum of foundational material: spaces of linear transformations; duality; determinants; minimal and characteristic polynomials; diagonalisability and triangularisability; inner product spaces; spectral theorems; singular value decompositions; bilinear and sesquilinear forms; Jordan normal forms.
